program_sflash_assets.title: Indicates whether to program the assets which are placed into SFLASH

program_hash.title: Enables ASSET_HASH and FACTORY_HASH validation in DEVELOPMENT LCS

nv_counter_a1.title: NV counter slot 1. 0, if no update

nv_counter_a2.title: NV counter slot 2. 0, if no update

prov_oem_complete.title: Indicates whether OEM assets are finalized in SFLASH and no further update is allowed

ap_cm33.title: Configures the CM33 debug access port availability in the PRODUCTION and DEVELOPMENT LCS

listen_window.title: Configures the listen window time to acquire the CM33 debug access port in the PRODUCTION LCS (in milliseconds)

cm33_dbg.title: Configures the invasive debug of CM33 core

cm33_nid.title: Configures the non-invasive debug of CM33 core

cm33_spid.title: Configures the secure privileged invasive debug of CM33 core

cm33_spnid.title: Configures the secure privileged non-invasive debug of CM33 core

cm33_secure.title: Enables the CM33 secure AP interface

ap.title: Configures the System debug access port availability in the PRODUCTION and DEVELOPMENT LCS

secure.title: Enables the system secure AP interface

boot_bank_ctr_offset.title: An offset from the start of each flash bank where a 32-bit counter for flash dual bank switching is placed

boot_hash_locking.title: Enable hash locking, fast authentication (compare a hash) instead of ECDSA

boot_bank_ctr_addr.title: An offset from the start of each flash bank where a 32-bit counter for flash dual bank switching is placed

boot_auth_images.title: Configures the images authentication and moving from a SSS after DFU update

boot_app_layout.title: The memory layout for the applications defined by BOOT_CFG_ID

dfu_enable.title: Indicates whether Device Firmware Update is enabled

disable_ramapp.title: Indicates whether RAM application execution is disabled

oem_rot_public_key_0.title: Path to the OEM RoT public key 0

oem_rot_public_key_1.title: Path to the OEM RoT public key 1

oem_debug_public_key.title: Path to the OEM debug public key

oem_dev_public_key.title: Path to the OEM RoT dev public key

oem_enc_key.title: Path to the DFU OEM encryption key

raw_data_pc012.title: Path to a binary file containing custom data accessible in PC0, PC1, and PC2. Up to 84 bytes
